items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: unless you want to go back to the days when it was Hertig and Seamon's Burlesque House

ctx.x: Tell me about playing the Apollo. You're listed as the first[white] [inaudible] to play the Apollo theater in New York.
Well, that's true, unless you want to go back to the days when it was Hertig and Seamon's Burlesque
House and there was a white band in the pit then. But at that time the audience was mostly white.
